title: FIPS gate missing: wolfssl aes_cbc update
description: wolfssl_aes_cbc_update() at src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_aes_cbc.c:248 is a gated callback (per crypto2dev_provider.h) but contains no fips_gate() call. First executable statement at line 257 is an argument check, not the gate. Trigger: user calls write() on an AES-CBC session while wolfCrypt FIPS boundary is degraded. Outcome: AES-CBC buffering proceeds without FIPS operational status check — FIPS compliance violation.
close_reason: Added wolfssl_fips_gate() as first statement in update() callbacks per FIPS 140-3 requirement
